evidence.scope: Uncalibrated inventory, contact-switch feasibility and shared-budget requirements, not material performance

grain.notes: Hypothetical local patches. Smooth sphere is only a whole-surface area reference, not measured branch surface or a minimum.

layer.notes: All layer values assumed. Fixed lateral area and thickness swelling. Water volume is all included liquid, not necessarily available lubricating water.

reservoir.notes: Ideal cylindrical off-load pocket, full water initially. No packing/strength proof. Laplace value assumes fully wetting water at50C; wettability of PE not assumed.

switch.notes: Linear h(theta)=h_d[1+(lambda-1)theta] is a hypothetical constitutive path. M is effective confined layer modulus on relevant time scale, not a quoted bulk Young modulus. Uncertainty includes rim, film and base deflection errors. Target wet fraction is a minimum capacity before rigid rim engagement, not a solved80% split. Clearance sensitivity is hypothetical; liquid bridges can persist across a geometric gap.

friction.notes: Assumed stress-test coefficients; no measured hydrogel value assigned to ski. Weights are normal-load fractions, never area fractions.

water.notes: Latent heat and heat supply are rounded scenario inputs. Energy fractions are not measured evaporation. Loss-flux cases are hypothetical net required supply before application losses. No claim of4h autonomous hydration.

budget.note: Inherited pretax hypothetical envelope, not a quote; 2% is a purchased replacement assumption, never an environmental release allowance. Equipment tax-inclusive JPY200M requirement is separate and unproven.

cost.notes: Regrafting costs per treated m2; add new material replacement separately. No vendor prices. Available annual margin shared with machining, stock, water, environment and testing.
